name: Snowpiercer
description: More than seven years after the world has become a frozen wasteland, the remnants of humanity inhabit a gigantic, perpetually-moving train that circles the globe as class warfare, social injustice and the politics of survival play out.

videos.title: Behind The Scenes: The Train
videos.overview: Explore the set of Snowpiercer and learn more about the cars from our Production Designer. Check out this behind-the-scenes video for a virtual tour of the train.

videos.title: Behind the Scenes: Class Warfare
videos.overview: Hear Daveed Diggs, Jennifer Connelly, showrunner Graeme Manson and more discuss the themes present on TNT's Snowpiercer - from class warfare to environmental change.

videos.title: “‘Twas The Train Before Christmas” by Mr. Wilford
videos.overview: Sean Bean, in character as Mr. Wilford, reads a Christmas story recapping Season 1 of Snowpiercer.

videos.title: Behind the Scenes: The Art of the Frozen World
videos.overview: Seven years after the world has become a frozen wasteland, the remnants of humanity inhabit a perpetually-moving train that circles the globe, where class warfare, social injustice and the politics of survival play out.

videos.title: First, the Weather Changed
videos.overview: A grisly murder stokes class division on Snowpiercer, the Great Ark Train. Melanie Cavill, the powerful head of hospitality, deputizes a dangerous rebel to help solve the killing -- Andre Layton, the world's only surviving homicide detective.

videos.title: Prepare to Brace
videos.overview: Layton uses his new position as train detective to investigate the murder while gathering intel for the revolution on the side. Meanwhile, Melanie faces a resource crisis, with potentially drastic consequences for the entire train.

videos.title: Access Is Power
videos.overview: Layton descends into the black market with Till, searching for both the killer and a valuable commodity for his revolution. Melanie stages a prize fight to distract the passengers from mounting class tension.

videos.title: Without Their Maker
videos.overview: A shocking twist in the murder investigation brings Layton and Till's manhunt to a cat-and-mouse climax. But Layton is getting too close to Melanie's big secret, which may prove the most dangerous game of all.

videos.title: Justice Never Boarded
videos.overview: Tensions between Third Class and First Class are boiling as Melanie stages the trial of the Snowpiercer killer. Third Class threatens a work stoppage, demanding representation on the jury, and Melanie makes a fateful decision about which side to favor.

videos.title: Trouble Comes Sideways
videos.overview: Hiding out with help from his allies, Layton lays track for revolution and an engineering emergency threatens every soul on Snowpiercer.

videos.title: The Universe Is Indifferent
videos.overview: On a divided Snowpiercer, Melanie intensifies her search for Layton while Layton is weaponizing her secret. Third Class faces a reckoning when he presents them with a choice.

videos.title: These Are His Revolutions
videos.overview: Revolution has finally come. As Layton leads the lower classes forward in armed rebellion, Melanie's house of cards collapses.

videos.title: The Train Demanded Blood
videos.overview: The rebel forces are on their heels when a dangerous foe joins them. A plan is hatched to take the train, but it may destroy them all.

videos.title: 994 Cars Long
videos.overview: In the revolution's aftermath, Layton and Melanie realize the greatest threat to their survival is right over their shoulder.

videos.title: The Time of Two Engines
videos.overview: Mr. Wilford arrives and threatens Snowpiercer, so Melanie makes a move that can't be undone.

videos.title: Smolder to Life
videos.overview: An exchange is made between the two trains, but a far greater revelation might be just over the horizon.

videos.title: A Great Odyssey
videos.overview: Melanie embarks on her most dangerous mission yet, while Layton reckons with his personal choices.

videos.title: A Single Trade
videos.overview: As the Big Alice crew are granted shore leave on Snowpiercer, Layton and Wilford have differing opinions on the future.

videos.title: Keep Hope Alive
videos.overview: Layton and Miss Audrey make a risky play for Big Alice, but Wilford has his own plans.

videos.title: Many Miles from Snowpiercer
videos.overview: Melanie fights for survival in treacherous conditions, vying to do what others before her could not.

videos.title: Our Answer for Everything
videos.overview: Layton and Till investigate the murders. Wilford leads Miss Audrey down a dark path.

videos.title: The Eternal Engineer
videos.overview: An engineering catastrophe on Snowpiercer forces Layton to make a difficult choice, one that might cost him everything.

videos.title: The Show Must Go On
videos.overview: Wilford presses forward on his endgame while those who are close with Layton grow anxious to learn their fates; Josie tests her newfound ability.

videos.title: Into the White
videos.overview: As the train approaches Melanie's retrieval point, Layton leads a furious attempt to try and pick her up but not without some sacrifices.

videos.title: The Tortoise and the Hare
videos.overview: While Wilford emphasizes his rule aboard his icy train, Layton's pirate train continues its dangerous quest for warm spots, and comes across something entirely unexpected.

videos.title: The Last to Go
videos.overview: Layton goes on the hunt, as Wilford works to boost morale. The resistance discovers a threat that could undermine everything they've worked for.

videos.title: The First Blow
videos.overview: It's a game of cat and mouse as both Layton and Wilford vie for the upper hand.

videos.title: Bound by One Track
videos.overview: Alex must finally deal with her parental figures as a track obstruction uncovers a painful past.

videos.title: A New Life
videos.overview: A series of terrorist attacks threatens to derail Layton and Zarah's big day.

videos.title: Born to Bleed
videos.overview: As the bomber is revealed, Layton comes to terms with his past decisions before making an irreversible call.

videos.title: Ouroboros
videos.overview: Layton realises some dreams are out of reach. As the rest of the train deals with Layton’s status change, Wilford makes a staggering discovery.

videos.title: Setting Itself Right
videos.overview: As the train detours from New Eden, an environmental catastrophe threatens everyone onboard.

videos.title: A Beacon for Us All
videos.overview: Reunited with old friends, the train throws a party. Alliances are tested as the truth is finally revealed.

videos.title: The Original Sinners
videos.overview: It all comes to a head as old adversaries clash, with New Eden hanging in the balance.

videos.title: Snakes in the Garden
videos.overview: The Snowpiercer crew marvel as a rocket shoots through the sky, crashing nearby. Melanie sends Till and Ben to investigate. Flash forward to nine months later, New Eden blooms.

videos.title: The Sting of Survival
videos.overview: Milius and his Animal Squad storm the train. Melanie realizes something is wrong and shuts the vault doors to the engine. But when Ben's life is threatened, Melanie surrenders the engine.

videos.title: Life Source
videos.overview: Layton demands to use Big Alice to rescue Liana. Ruth, now Mayor of New Eden, refuses because it's the town's power supply. Layton makes Javi jury-rig a solution, giving them three weeks of electricity.

videos.title: North Star
videos.overview: Big Alice catches up to Snowpiercer. Milius radios them, inviting Layton over. Sensing a trap, Layton and Josie sneak onto Snowpiercer. Nima is worried Layton will be gassed and attempts to disarm the Greenhouse Car.

videos.title: The Engineer
videos.overview: Layton hears the deal: Liana for Big Alice. He agrees and the trains dock at the silo. While Layton, Ben, Till, Ruth, and Alex stew in a holding room, Josie is taken to Headwood. Milius introduces his partner in crime: Wilford.

videos.title: Bell the Cat
videos.overview: Nima needs more samples for his experiments, so Milius sends Wilford and the soldiers to collect. Privately, Milius tells Wolf to kill Wilford. Layton wakes up on an abandoned floor and is approached by humans with toxic gas scars.

videos.title: A Moth to a Flame
videos.overview: Layton learns who was responsible for the experiments on Josie and Liana, before also finding out who froze the world.

videos.title: By Weeping Cross
videos.overview: Big Alice pulls into New Eden. Layton, Josie, and Liana sit stranded in the middle of nowhere, freezing to death, when a masked soldier appears. Can he rescue them? Alex finds herself in danger.

videos.title: Dominant Traits
videos.overview: Alex sabotages the track switch computer and, with Layton's help, escapes to town hall. Till gets the drop on Ace and uses his sniper rifle to save Layton and Alex from Rat. Melanie reveals the identity of Alex's biological father.

videos.title: Last Stop
videos.overview: Nima heads for Snowpiercer. Layton and the Tailies fight their way uptrain when Ruth is captured. Nima tries to cut a deal and runs to the rocket control room to initiate the launch sequence, but who is trying to sabotage the rocket?

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 10 wins & 34 nominations total
